comment: Corrected C-first source candidate for pray.c:pleased -> give_spell. Dismiss the startup pager before moving east. Wish a blessed luckstone, neutral altar, one lawful white unicorn corpse and seven red dragon corpses before offering; this batches wiz-wish cooldown increments so high-value altar offerings can clear the initial ublesscnt and then add Luck. The corpse pile is offered in floor-letter order o-v with confirmation, followed by the wizard-only force-success prayer response. The previous stacked-wish attempt lacked the initial welcome-page dismissal and is preserved as setup evidence.
